title: Chassidishe Rebbes Postpone Rally
body: Leading chassidishe rebbes have ruled to postpone a protest rally against the Israeli draft law by one day to avoid ביטול תורה and ensure yeshiva students participate during suspended learning schedules.

title: Rav Offers Shidduch Reward
body: Rav Yitzchak Zilberstein pledged to pay 1,000 shekels to any kollel member who finds a shidduch for an older single girl in need. The offer was made at a kollel in Cholon during the fast of Asarah B'Teves.

title: Chareidi Rift Deepens
body: Degel HaTorah official slams Deri, saying he still holds sway despite opposition, amid deepening rift between chareidi parties over Yerushalayim Religious Council chair appointment.
